User: User principal (email) in the row-level-security mapping table.
Main School ID: School identifier a user is authorized to see, in the row-level-security mapping table.
Hispanic or Latino: Whether the student identifies as Hispanic or Latino.
Cohort Graduation Year (RPT_DT_D_STUDENT: Expected on-time high-school graduation year for the student's cohort.
Recommended Record: Flag marking the single recommended demographic record to use when a student has multiple (1 = use this record).
Student School: Name of the school the student is currently attending.
Is Fay (RPT_DT_D_STUDENT_DEMOGRAPHICS): Full Academic Year flag — whether the student was enrolled for the full academic year (accountability inclusion).
Student Identity Id (RPT_DT_D_STUDENT_DE: Stable unique identifier for the student across schools and years.
Career Learning: Career Learning program segment/indicator for the school or student.
Grade Band: Grouped grade range (e.g., K-5, 6-8, 9-12) derived from grade level.
Ap Course Count: Number of Advanced Placement (AP) courses the student is enrolled in.
Cc Att Req Flag: Flag: student is required to attend Class Connect (live synchronous) sessions.
Cc Hrs Attend Opt L 7 D: Hours of optional Class Connect sessions attended in the last 7 days.
Cc Hrs Attend Req L 7 D: Hours of required Class Connect sessions attended in the last 7 days.
Cd Ela Flag: Course-deficiency indicator flag for ELA (1 = deficiency present).
Cd Mth Flag: Course-deficiency indicator flag for Math (1 = deficiency present).
Cd Total Flag: Course-deficiency indicator flag for overall (1 = deficiency present).
Cohort Graduation Year: Expected on-time high-school graduation year for the student's cohort.
Course Failing Bckt: Bucketed category of how many courses the student is failing.
Course Failing Count: Number of courses the student is currently failing.
Course Passing: Share of the student's courses currently passing.
Course Passing Count: Number of courses the student is currently passing.
Days Since Act: Days since the student's last course activity.
Days W Act L 7 D: Number of days with course activity in the last 7 days.
Ela Boy to Eoy Growth: ELA assessment growth from beginning-of-year to end-of-year.
Ela Boy to Moy Growth: ELA assessment growth from beginning-of-year to middle-of-year.
Ela Cc Att Req Flag: Flag: student is required to attend ELA Class Connect (live synchronous) sessions.
Ela Cc Hrs Attend Opt L 7 D: Hours of optional ELA Class Connect sessions attended in the last 7 days.
Ela Cc Hrs Attend Req L 7 D: Hours of required ELA Class Connect sessions attended in the last 7 days.
Ela Cc Hrs Invited Req L 7 D: Hours of required ELA Class Connect sessions the student was invited to in the last 7 days.
Ela Course Duration L 7 D: Total time spent in ELA courses over the last 7 days.
Ela Crs Ct: Number of ELA courses the student is enrolled in.
Ela Grade Quintile: Performance quintile (1-5 bucket) of the student's ELA grade.
Ela Mtss Match: Whether the student's assigned ELA MTSS tier matches the recommended tier.
Ela Mtss Rec: Recommended ELA MTSS intervention tier for the student based on performance data.
Ela Mtss Tier: ELA MTSS (Multi-Tiered System of Supports) intervention tier assigned to the student.
Ela Pass Ct: Number of ELA courses the student is passing.
Ela Rem Tool: ELA remediation tool/program assigned to the student.
Ela Rem Wkly Time: Weekly time spent in ELA remediation.
Ethnicity Id: Numeric identifier for the student's ethnicity.
Four Wk Avg Course Act: Four-week rolling average of course activity.
Ft Pt Status: Whether the student is enrolled full-time or part-time.
Honors Course Count: Number of honors courses the student is enrolled in.
Interim Benchmark Ela: Whether the student met the ELA interim assessment benchmark (1 = met).
Interim Benchmark Ela Eoy: Whether the student met the ELA interim assessment benchmark (end-of-year) (1 = met).
Interim Benchmark Ela Moy: Whether the student met the ELA interim assessment benchmark (middle-of-year) (1 = met).
Interim Benchmark Mth: Whether the student met the Math interim assessment benchmark (1 = met).
Interim Benchmark Mth Eoy: Whether the student met the Math interim assessment benchmark (end-of-year) (1 = met).
Interim Benchmark Mth Moy: Whether the student met the Math interim assessment benchmark (middle-of-year) (1 = met).
Interim Participation Ela: Whether the student participated in the ELA interim assessment (1 = participated).
Interim Participation Ela Eoy: Whether the student participated in the ELA interim assessment (end-of-year) (1 = participated).
Interim Participation Ela Moy: Whether the student participated in the ELA interim assessment (middle-of-year) (1 = participated).
Interim Participation Mth: Whether the student participated in the Math interim assessment (1 = participated).
Interim Participation Mth Eoy: Whether the student participated in the Math interim assessment (end-of-year) (1 = participated).
Interim Participation Mth Moy: Whether the student participated in the Math interim assessment (middle-of-year) (1 = participated).
Is Fay: Full Academic Year flag — whether the student was enrolled for the full academic year (accountability inclusion).
Kpi Met Cc Ela: Flag indicating whether the student met the ELA Class Connect attendance KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Cc Mth: Flag indicating whether the student met the Math Class Connect attendance KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Cc Overall: Flag indicating whether the student met the overall Class Connect attendance KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Course Ela: Flag indicating whether the student met the ELA course-activity KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Course Mth: Flag indicating whether the student met the Math course-activity KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Course Overall: Flag indicating whether the student met the overall course-activity KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Crs Act: Flag indicating whether the student met the course-activity KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Pass All: Flag indicating whether the student met the passing-all-courses KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Pass Ela: Flag indicating whether the student met the ELA passing KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Pass Mth: Flag indicating whether the student met the Math passing KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Priority Ela: Flag indicating whether the student met the ELA priority-intervention KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Priority Mth: Flag indicating whether the student met the Math priority-intervention KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Rem Ela: Flag indicating whether the student met the ELA remediation KPI (Yes/No).
Kpi Met Rem Mth: Flag indicating whether the student met the Math remediation KPI (Yes/No).
Main School Id: Identifier of the student's primary (home) school.
Missed Days Ytd: Number of school days missed year-to-date.
Mth Boy to Eoy Growth: Math assessment growth from beginning-of-year to end-of-year.
Mth Boy to Moy Growth: Math assessment growth from beginning-of-year to middle-of-year.
Mth Cc Att Req Flag: Flag: student is required to attend Math Class Connect (live synchronous) sessions.
Mth Cc Hrs Attend Opt L 7 D: Hours of optional Math Class Connect sessions attended in the last 7 days.
Mth Cc Hrs Attend Req L 7 D: Hours of required Math Class Connect sessions attended in the last 7 days.
Mth Cc Hrs Invited Req L 7 D: Hours of required Math Class Connect sessions the student was invited to in the last 7 days.
Mth Course Duration L 7 D: Total time spent in Math courses over the last 7 days.
Mth Crs Ct: Number of Math courses the student is enrolled in.
Mth Grade Quintile: Performance quintile (1-5 bucket) of the student's Math grade.
Mth Mtss Match: Whether the student's assigned Math MTSS tier matches the recommended tier.
Mth Mtss Rec: Recommended Math MTSS intervention tier for the student based on performance data.
Mth Mtss Tier: Math MTSS (Multi-Tiered System of Supports) intervention tier assigned to the student.
Mth Pass Ct: Number of Math courses the student is passing.
Mth Rem Tool: Math remediation tool/program assigned to the student.
Mth Rem Wkly Time: Weekly time spent in Math remediation.
New Returning Flag: Whether the student is new to the school this year or returning.
Pass All Bckt: Bucketed category summarizing whether the student is passing all courses.
Pass All Flag: Flag: student is passing all enrolled courses (1 = yes).
Pass All Flag Ela: Flag: student is passing all ELA courses (1 = yes).
Pass All Flag His: Flag: student is passing all History courses (1 = yes).
Pass All Flag Mth: Flag: student is passing all Math courses (1 = yes).
Pass All Flag Sci: Flag: student is passing all Science courses (1 = yes).
Persistence: Student persistence status — whether the student remains actively enrolled/engaged.
Py Ela Num Prof Levels: Number of proficiency levels in the prior-year ELA state assessment scale.
Py Ela Proficiency Number: Prior-year ELA proficiency level as a number.
Py Ela Proficient Flag: Flag: student was proficient on the prior-year ELA state assessment (1 = proficient).
Py Ela Test Date: Date of the prior-year ELA state assessment.
Py Ela Test Name: Name of the prior-year ELA state assessment.
Py Mth Num Prof Levels: Number of proficiency levels in the prior-year Math state assessment scale.
Py Mth Proficiency Number: Prior-year Math proficiency level as a number.
Py Mth Proficient Flag: Flag: student was proficient on the prior-year Math state assessment (1 = proficient).
Py Mth Test Date: Date of the prior-year Math state assessment.
Py Mth Test Name: Name of the prior-year Math state assessment.
Rem Wk Range: Bucketed weekly range of remediation time.
Report Date: Date of the reporting snapshot for this record.
School Entry Date: Date the student entered the school.
School of Record: The school officially responsible for the student's record and reporting.
School Start Date: Start date of the student's current school enrollment.
School Student Key: Surrogate key uniquely identifying a student–school–snapshot record; the primary grain of the model and the key used for distinct student counts.
School Year Start Date: Start date of the academic year.
Slicer Date: Date value used to drive date slicer/parameter selection in downstream reports.
Start Status: Student's enrollment start status for the term/year.
Student Identity Id: Stable unique identifier for the student across schools and years.
Total Course Duration L 7 D: Total time spent in courses over the last 7 days.
Ytd Avg Days Course Act: Year-to-date average number of days with course activity.
School Type: Type of school (e.g., online public, private).
Standardized Ethnicity: Student's ethnicity mapped to a standardized category.
Standardized Ethnicity (RPT_DT_D_STUDENT: Student's ethnicity mapped to a standardized category.
Sams Student Id: Student's identifier in the SAMS student administration system.
School Group: Grouping the school belongs to (e.g., management group).
School Student Key (RPT_DT_D_STUDENT_DEM: Surrogate key uniquely identifying a student–school–snapshot record; the primary grain of the model and the key used for distinct student counts.
User (RLS Table): Reference to the authorized user (email) from the RLS security table, used to evaluate row visibility.
Main School Id (RPT_DT_D_STUDENT_DEMOGRA: Identifier of the student's primary (home) school.
RLSFlag: Row-level-security flag (computed): 'true' when the current user is permitted to see this student's row (member of AIM team or matched via the RLS table).
SUPPORT_TIER: School support tier. NOTE: this column is currently an unresolved reference (source column RPT_DT_D_SCHOOL.SUPPORT_TIER is missing) and must be repointed before it will populate.
